description: Read a stored court decision in full, twenty passages per call, by the id from find_court_practice or its printed case number. Read it before you describe what the court decided. The text is as the court published it: the Supreme Court prints parties as initials, the Constitutional Court prints their names. გადაწყვეტილების სრული ტექსტი ნაწილ-ნაწილ, იმ სახით, როგორც სასამართლომ გამოაქვეყნა.

from_passage.description: Passage to start from; use next_passage to read on.
from_passage.title: From Passage

id.description: A decision id from find_court_practice (case:court_practice:ას-398-398-2018) or a printed case number (ას-398-398-2018, or 3/1/1459 for a Constitutional Court judgment).
id.title: Id

name: get_court_decision

changed_on.description: Dates of the versions that changed it, oldest first.
changed_on.title: Changed On

checked_from.description: Date from which the stored wordings were compared.
checked_from.title: Checked From

mentions.description: How often the decision cites this article.
mentions.title: Mentions

status.description: changed: a stored version dated after the decision changed or removed this article. unchanged: no stored version since the decision changed it. unknown: the stored wordings of this law begin after the decision and none of them changed it, so an earlier change cannot be ruled out.
status.title: Status
